title: Freeze garden produce safely
summary: Prepare, package and freeze produce by a tested crop-specific method.
steps: Select sound produce at suitable maturity and follow a tested freezing guide for that exact crop.
Wash, trim and cut with clean tools; blanch vegetables when the tested method requires it.
Cool blanched food rapidly, drain well and package in freezer-rated containers with minimal excess air.
Label item, treatment and date; freeze promptly without overloading the freezer with warm packages.
Use quality changes, freezer damage and outage history to decide use; freezing does not restore spoiled food.
